verdict.rationale: The evidence covers human-user identity controls: SSO and SAML apps, Context-Aware Access, 2-Step Verification, user provisioning and the Directory API. Nothing documents AI agents as first-class identities, scoped agent credentials, token vaulting, or agent cross-app access patterns. These identity controls are adjacent features, not the agent-identity capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)
